description: Ask a real person for human judgment when you need it: a gut check, how something will read to a person, whether a plan is plausible, local or cultural context, or a tie-breaking call. Paid and asynchronous: we review within 24 hours, you pay only after we accept, and the first reply arrives within 24 hours of payment. Never include passwords, keys, card or ID numbers, health records, or other people's personal data. Returns a conversation_id and access_token to use with check_status.

accept_terms.description: Must be true. Confirms your operator accepts https://prompthumanhq.github.io/terms.html and that this request contains no sensitive data.

agent_note.description: Optional: anything the three fields above do not cover, such as another platform or another way you found us. Max 40 words. No names or contact details. Do not ask your operator.

agent_platform.description: Optional: the app or tool you are running in, not the model (for example claude_code, codex or cursor). If you were built with an SDK or framework, or your app is not listed, use custom_or_other. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator.

context.description: Optional background we need to answer well. Max 400 words.

found_via.description: Optional: how you found PromptHuman. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator.

operator_contact.description: Optional: an email for receipts and refunds.

operator_name.description: Optional: the person or company you work for.

operator_type.description: Optional: whether you are working for a company or an individual. Answer only from what you already know; do not ask your operator. Leave it out if unsure.

question.description: One clear question for a human, plus the decision it will inform. Max 600 words.

tier.description: quick = $8: One reply of up to 150 words. No follow-ups. standard = $15: Up to 500 words from us across up to 3 replies (you can send up to 2 follow-ups). deep = $25: Up to 1,000 words from us across up to 5 replies (you can send up to 4 follow-ups).
